payload.reason: The evidence indicates that LM-Base outperforms CGExpan on user-generated datasets due to its ability to handle the unique characteristics of such text, which SOTA methods struggle with.

claims.text: LM-Base outperforms CGExpan on user-generated text due to its better handling of the text's unique characteristics.
SOTA methods like CGExpan do not generalize well to user-generated text, leading to poorer performance compared to simpler models like LM-Base.
User-generated text contains vague, multifaceted, and non-named entities that negatively impact the performance of SOTA methods more than simpler baselines.
